issue.title: Preview-build: binary APKs only, comment linked ticket, move to In QA
issue.body:
## Summary

When the `preview-build` label runs [`.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/blob/main/.github/workflows/preview-build.yml):

1. Always build a **fresh Android preview APK** (binary only — **never** OTA / shared `preview` channel), so multiple QA builds can exist at once.
2. Post (or replace) the same bot install comment on the **PR** and each **linked Project 4 ticket**.
3. Best-effort move linked tickets to Project 4 Status **`In QA`**.

## Current vs expected

- **Before:** JS-only PRs published OTA to a shared `preview` channel (one active update clobbered others); comments only on the PR.
- **Expected:** Every labeled PR gets its own internal APK (Updates disabled on `preview` profile). Same install comment on PR + linked issues. Linked cards move to **`In QA`** when safe.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Remove JS-only / OTA path from `preview-build.yml`; always `FORCE_NEW_BUILD` APK.
- Disable Expo Updates for EAS profile `preview` (keep production Updates).
- Upsert ticket comments + Project 4 `In QA` handoff.
- Docs: QA guide, CI / EAS / onboarding READMEs.

**Out of scope**
- Nightly Slack flow.
- Side-by-side installs on one device (same package id).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `preview-build` always produces a fresh Android APK (no `eas update`).
- [ ] Preview profile has Expo Updates disabled so concurrent QA APKs are not overwritten by a channel.
- [ ] Successful preview posts/updates build info on linked ticket(s), not only the PR.
- [ ] Linked ticket(s) move to Project 4 Status **`In QA`** when previously in an allowed eng status.
- [ ] Product-owned / terminal statuses are not overwritten.
- [ ] PRs with no linked issues still work (PR comment only; no hard failure).
- [ ] Docs describe binary-only preview + ticket comment + `In QA` handoff.

## File pointers

- `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`
- `.github/scripts/eas-resolve-android-build.sh` (`FORCE_NEW_BUILD`)
- `.github/scripts/preview-notify-linked-issues.js`
- `app.config.ts` / `eas.json`
- `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`
